explore.title: Explore
explore.subtitle: Search and download books from Anna’s Archive.
explore.noQuery: Type a title or author to search Anna’s Archive.
explore.downloadBookBody:
Due to server download protections (Cloudflare), we will open the page in your phone's browser.

1. Download the file to your phone.
2. Return to the app and add it in the "Library" tab via "Choose file".
explore.unavailableBody: All known mirrors are unavailable. Try again later or check your internet connection.
explore.importSuccessBody: “{{title}}” has been added to your library.
explore.loadingHint: The first search may take a few seconds.

addBook.onlineDesc: Find a book online and download it directly into your library. No phone storage access is needed.
addBook.title: Add custom text
addBook.fileDesc: Choose a .epub or .txt file from your device. Convert PDFs to text via the external site (p2r3.github.io/convert) and import the resulting .txt.
addBook.pdfConvertBody: PDF files aren't parsed in the app. Open the external site (p2r3.github.io/convert) that turns a PDF into text? Once converted, come back here and import the resulting .txt file.
addBook.pdfEncrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Decrypt it first (e.g. with the free qpdf tool: "qpdf --decrypt --password PASSWORD file.pdf decrypted.pdf") and try again, preferably via the conversion site.
